description: No clean concept found. The strongest firing is in mid or late games right after the opponent drops a stone in column 1 (rows 3-4 counting from 1) or at row 4 of column 4, leaving me one sensible reply, usually in column 1 or 4, often directly on top of that stone. Most firing positions do not fit this, and simple early forced blocks in those columns do not fire.
effect: Weak. Forcing it high moves at most about 0.1-0.2 probability, slightly toward column 1 (or 2) and away from column 3 in undecided positions; no measurable change when the move is forced.
notes: 7 dev scores, all F1 0.13-0.23. Tried: forced move in col 1 (0.19), last stone at hot cells (0.19), block on top of last stone (0.14), col-1 shape with tall cols 2-3 (0.17), combined points rule (0.227, best; P .34 R .17, sim share 0.03). Minimal pairs showed board ownership of cols 2-3 and turn parity matter in ways I could not reduce to a rule. Could be a mixture or a random direction. Synthesis 1 (5.495) beats the dev max 5.442.
